title: Be Still
subtitle: Five Days with the Psalms of Trust
description: Five of the Bible’s great songs of trust, from the Shepherd Psalm to “you have searched me and you know me,” each paired with a painting to pray with. A gentle first retreat for anyone who is tired, anxious or simply wants to rest in God.

images: Day 1: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo (1617–1682), The Good Shepherd, c. 1660. Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 2: Ivan Aivazovsky (1817–1900), The Ninth Wave, 1850. State Russian Museum, Saint Petersburg. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 3: Caspar David Friedrich (1774–1840), Morning in the Riesengebirge, 1810–1811. Charlottenburg Palace, Berlin (Prussian Palaces and Gardens Foundation). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 4: Raphael (1483–1520), The Tempi Madonna, 1508. Alte Pinakothek, Munich. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 5: Vincent van Gogh (1853–1890), The Starry Night, 1889. Museum of Modern Art, New York. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

title: I Am
subtitle: Six Days with the “I Am” Sayings of Jesus
description: Six times in John’s Gospel Jesus says “I am” and names himself with the ordinary things of life: bread, light, a shepherd, a road, a vine. Pray with one saying each day, from “I am the bread of life” to “I am the true vine,” with a great painting to help you stay with him.

images: Day 1: Juan de Juanes (c. 1507–1579), The Last Supper, c. 1562. Museo del Prado, Madrid. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 2: William Holman Hunt (1827–1910), The Light of the World, 1851–1853. Keble College, Oxford. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 3: Bernhard Plockhorst (1825–1907), The Good Shepherd, late 19th century. Original location unknown; widely reproduced as a print. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 4: Sebastiano del Piombo (c. 1485–1547), The Raising of Lazarus, 1517–1519. National Gallery, London. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 5: Unknown Byzantine icon painter, Christ Pantocrator, 6th century. Saint Catherine’s Monastery, Sinai. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
Day 6: Vincent van Gogh (1853–1890), The Red Vineyard, 1888. Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
